name: Phobia
source:
The younger generation these days just don’t have the guts they need to survive their day-to-day lives. They think a pill will fix all their problems, when the issue is their mindsets. They think medicine will magically make the world safer to live in.

It’s not even as dangerous as it used to be- back in your day, there were real things to worry about. International conflict, criminals on the street, killer clowns….

Your most recent patient is the worst of all your younger clients. The man’s afraid of everything. His own shadow could send him down a spiral!

So when he suddenly gains enough confidence to threaten you in your own office, it leaves a sickly, twisted feeling in your stomach… one that neither a pill nor breathing exercise can diminish.

[From [url=https://aexstv.itch.io/phobia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如今的年轻一代根本没有生存日常生活所需的勇气。他们认为一粒药就能解决所有问题，但问题出在他们的心态上。他们认为医学会神奇地让世界变得更安全。

它甚至不像以前那样危险，有真正需要担心的事情。国际冲突、街头罪犯、杀人小丑……

你最近的病人是所有年轻客户中最糟糕的。男人害怕一切。他自己的影子可能会让他陷入螺旋式下降！

因此，当他突然有足够的信心在你自己的办公室威胁你时，你的胃里会留下一种恶心、扭曲的感觉……这种感觉是药物和呼吸练习都无法消除的。

[来自[url=https://aexstv.itch.io/phobia]itch.io[/url]]
